Deepline | NYC (ONSITE) | Founding Full-stack Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers | $160k–$230k + meaningful equity

User interfaces are dead. Knowledge workers will exclusively work through agent interfaces like Claude Code/Cowork. We've built the interface layer to enable that.

One API that unifies hundreds of data providers, workflows, and data infrastructure to agents like Claude Code. This is GTM as code — Stripe is to financial infrastructure what Deepline is to GTM infrastructure. Hundreds of users signing up weekly / +50% growth each month since Feb.

You'd build core platform: agent-facing abstractions, infrastructure, UI. TypeScript/Python/Next.js/Postgres. $3.3M raised from Lerer Hippeau + Looker founding team. Technical founding team from Uber, Lyft, Capchase, MIT, Waterloo.
